name: Termômetro do Mercado Solar – Análise Diária

parameters.query: SELECT message_id, sender_name, group_name, group_jid, message_timestamp, message_type, ddd, content_text FROM public.messages WHERE DATE(message_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') = (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day') AND content_text IS NOT NULL AND content_text <> '' AND group_jid LIKE '%-%' AND group_name NOT ILIKE '%FOTUS DISTRIBUIDORA SOLAR%' ORDER BY message_timestamp ASC
